name: agent-config
description: Set up AI agent configuration for an existing Entur repository: AGENTS.md, tool permissions, formatting hooks, and Entur skill recommendations.

interface.shortDescription: Set up AI agent configuration for an existing Entur repository.
interface.longDescription: Analyzes an existing Entur repository and generates an AGENTS.md referencing Entur-wide standards, configures agent tool permissions and an optional formatting hook, recommends Entur skills, and updates .gitignore.
